quote: Was gonna rate it a 2 or 3 because it wasnt the WORST game I've ever played, but I had my entire review written out when this terrible site deleted everything I wrote so now it gets a zero. Im not writing it again. Besides, this will help even out all the artificial 10s "people" have been giving this game. Mid game, terrible characters and story, and its dreadfully boring.
